title: Queen of Shadows
description: Queen of Shadows — The Townstons wiki
html:
The Queen of Shadows

The Queen of Shadows (The Shadow's Embrace) Level 50-100

Skills:

  • Summon Dark Angels
  • Mortal Strike
  • Fear

Resistances:

  • Low PoisonResist
  • Low FireResist
  • Low IceResist
  • IMMUNE against Shadow
  • No Divine Resist

It appears the Queen of Shadows will not move until actually attacked. Instead, if you try to fight the support troops first she continually spawns new ones.

Support

Shadowspawn Knights, Dark Angels, Phantasms

For tips on fighting The Queen of Shadows, check out Queen of Shadows Boss Guide.
